metadata.title: HDBLAST: Registered Matched Minimal Stress and Independent Mode Calibration
metadata.description:
Prospectively registered fixed-geometry linear scalar-to-stress calibration at H=1, fixed subtraction reference r=2, minimal coupling, incoming Euclidean/Bunch-Davies state. Two compact smooth mass pulses, six observation times and K=64,128,256 are frozen with code and acceptance gates before evaluation. Independent extended-precision forced modes calculate physical minimal density and pressure directly, with explicit mass contacts and complete inherited W2/W4 subtraction. Separate matched memory formulas, finite-cutoff trace terms, and a Simpson energy-conservation ledger test the calculation.

Constructive directed interval bounds apply to omitted momentum bands. Time/momentum quadrature, mode refinement, subtraction arithmetic and ledger integration retain separate empirical estimates and allowances; the total solution is not certified by interval arithmetic. First-order relative vacuum polarization is distinct from second-order positive canonical excitation energy and from heating. Actual stationary-root and metric response, bulk boundary conditions, quantum initial data, coupled evolution and stability remain open. No observational support for extra dimensions or a Big-Bang origin is established. Reviews are internal and AI-assisted. Text, figures and data use CC BY 4.0; code uses MIT. This prepared metadata is not evidence of a Zenodo deposit or new DOI.
